commands.command:
printf 'Defaults syslog=local2\n' | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.d/99-sudo-command-log
sudo visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/99-sudo-command-log
sudo chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/99-sudo-command-log
cat /etc/sudoers.d/99-sudo-command-log

printf 'local2.*    /var/log/sudo-commands.log\nlocal2.*    stop\n' | sudo tee /etc/rsyslog.d/10-sudo-commands.conf
sudo touch /var/log/sudo-commands.log
sudo chmod 0640 /var/log/sudo-commands.log
sudo chown syslog:adm /var/log/sudo-commands.log
sudo systemctl restart rsyslog
sudo systemctl is-active rsyslog

MARKER="sudo-log-test-$(date +%s)"
sudo -k
sudo /bin/echo "$MARKER"
sleep 1
echo "--- sudo-commands.log ---"
sudo tail -5 /var/log/sudo-commands.log
echo "--- syslog grep ---"
sudo grep -c "$MARKER" /var/log/syslog
echo "--- auth.log grep ---"
sudo grep -c "$MARKER" /var/log/auth.log
